# FlareMo

FlareMo 是 Cloudflare 原生的个人知识管理系统，提供 Memos 兼容 API 子集。

## 必读

- README: ./README.md
- 技术栈: ./docs/tech-stack.md
- 架构: ./docs/architecture-notes.md
- 部署: ./docs/deploy.md
- Agent 部署: ./docs/agent-deploy.md
- Agent Memory: ./docs/agent-memory.md
- Agent Memory CLI: ./bin/flaremo（npm install -g . 后可用；lens/recall/remember/checkpoint/status/seed）
- Agent Memory Skill: ./skills/flaremo-memory/SKILL.md
- 发版: ./docs/release.md
- 维护: ./docs/maintenance.md
- Memos 兼容矩阵: ./docs/memos-compatibility.md
- 从 Memos 迁移: ./docs/import-from-memos.md
- Memos 生态兼容记录: ./docs/memos-ecosystem.md
- English deploy docs: ./docs/en/deploy.md
- 路线: ./ROADMAP.md
- Agent 指南: ./AGENTS.md

## 关键事实

- Runtime: Cloudflare Workers
- Web: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/radix primitives
- Database: Cloudflare D1 + Drizzle
- Object storage: Cloudflare R2
- Auth boundary: Better Auth cookie/PAT；Cloudflare Access 为可选外层防线
- Public API: Memos-compatible `/api/v1/*`
- App API: `/api/app/*`

## 质量门禁

```bash
pnpm format:check
pnpm verify  # 全量门禁，仅在维护者明确要求时本地运行
pnpm deploy:dry-run
pnpm backup:drill
```

仓库有瘦 CI（.github/workflows/ci.yml：format / lint / typecheck / 单元测试，约 14 分钟）作为 push 与外部 PR 的快速门禁；它不跑 E2E、不构建、不做部署。全量 `pnpm verify` 只在维护者明确要求时本地执行（发版默认不跑）；日常提交按改动跑定向测试，E2E 一律 opt-in。
